row.notes: vt_Sess_ControllerSystem slot 11 (+0x58): builds every ControllerSet. Sets byte [sys+0x366]=1 on entry; when [[sys+0x50]+0xe8] is set creates one 0x60-byte ControllerSet per vehicle-manager entry (Game_ControllerSet_Create at 0x14389be41; human controller when the slot is player-controlled) and one AI-only set per spectator-list entry (0x14389c003), appends each to [sys+0x30..+0x38) and sets byte [sys+0x365]=1; then zeroes every set's flags (0x14389c2a2) and rewrites each mode pair with fresh random keys (mode 1 AI when the human controller is null, else 0 HUMAN), logging 'ControllerSet(%d / %s) : cleared flags.' per set. Only caller of Game_ControllerSet_Create. Renamed from Game_ControllerSet_ClearFlags (V1505, V1533). The paired destroy is Sess_ControllerSystem_DestroySets. Callers: census steam 0x389bc50.

verify.notes: V1505 Not a per-set ClearFlags. It is vt_Sess_ControllerSystem slot 11 (+0x58): builds one ControllerSet per car (Game_ControllerSet_Create at 0x14389be42 for vehicles, 0x14389c004 for the spectator list; human controller when the car's slot is player-controlled, mode = HUMAN else AI), sets [sys+0x365], then runs a second loop over [sys+0x30..+0x38) that zeroes flags [set+0x30] and re-randomises mode (HUMAN when a human controller exists, else AI), logging 'cleared flags'. V1533 Claim checked: this is the system's build-all (vt_Sess_ControllerSystem slot 11 = +0x58, raw read 0x14389bc50), not a per-set ClearFlags. It sets byte [sys+0x366]=1 on entry; when [[sys+0x50]+0xe8] is set it creates one 0x60-byte ControllerSet per vehicle-manager entry (human controller when the slot is player-controlled; args vehicle, hasHuman, !hasHuman) then one AI-only set per spectator-list entry, appends each to [sys+0x30..+0x38) and sets byte [sys+0x365]=1 (only inside that branch). It then sets flags [set+0x30]=0 for every set and rewrites the mode pair (+0x10 ^ +0x18 = 1 when the human controller [set+0x20] is null, else 0) with fresh random keys, logging 'cleared flags.' per set. Only callers of Game_ControllerSet_Create (0x1438968e0) are 0x14389be41 and 0x14389c003 inside it; the only reference to the function is the vtable slot. The KB name Game_ControllerSet_ClearFlags is wrong; role is Sess_ControllerSystem_BuildSets.
